content: Real estate/marketplace card anatomy: cover photo first, price always visible and never animated in (users scan price to filter mentally), location/neighborhood next to or under price since buyers search by neighborhood as much as by features, then a consistent bed/bath/area icon row -- format must be identical across all cards (e.g. always '2 qts' not sometimes '2 quartos'). Optional badges (novo/destaque) absolute-positioned on the photo.
